column_description: A VARCHAR(30) primary key identifying the encounter (e.g., 'ENC001').
A TIMESTAMP for when the encounter or record was created/logged.
A VARCHAR(20) referencing the clinician ID (not an enforced FK).
A VARCHAR(20) referencing the facility ID (not an enforced FK).
A NUMERIC(2,1) capturing how many appointments were missed or how frequently (e.g., 1.0).
An enum (treatmentbarriers_enum) indicating barriers to treatment (Multiple, Time, Financial, Transportation).
A DATE capturing the next appointment date (e.g., '2025-06-10').
A SMALLINT data quality score (0–100 scale).
A VARCHAR(250) note on assessment completeness (e.g., 'Sections B & C incomplete').
